articles.summary: Niagen Bioscience, Inc., the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced that it has selected Evotec, a global life science company specializing in drug discovery and development, as a contract research organization to support the advancement of NB4168. The work will be conducted in collaboration with NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp., Niagen Bioscience’s wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for accelerated aging and rare genetic diseases.
